newsitem.title: UK: Two bombs explode in northern English town - BBC.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs explode in northern English town - BBC.

text.p: Two bombs exploded in the centre of the northwestern English town of Wilmslow early on Wednesday, BBC radio said.
Police had received warnings before the devices exploded and there were no immediate reports of injuries, it said.
One device exploded at the town's railway station at just before 7 a.m. (0700) while the other went off at the police station.
BBC television quoted local fire services as saying a coded warning had been received before the blasts.
It was not immediuately clear who might have been behind the blasts. The Irish Republican Army has set off several bombs on the English mainland since ending a 17-month ceasefire in February 1996.
